homeBase.label: Home Base — Ravenswood
homeBase.note: 5 min walk to the Damen Brown Line stop; buses on Damen, Lincoln & Western nearby.

days.label: Friday
days.title: Getting Settled
days.objective: Drive in from Lexington, get keys, and ease into Ravenswood / Lincoln Square / Andersonville — records, pastries, and a jazz nightcap within stumbling distance of home.

stops.title: Hit the Road
stops.description: I-65 N → I-90/94 W, approx. 6 hrs incl. stops. Clocks fall back an hour crossing into Central Time.

stops.title: Home Base: Ravenswood
stops.description: Drop bags, unload the car, get oriented.

stops.title: Laurie's Planet of Sound
stops.description: 25-year neighborhood record store institution, 6 min walk from home base.

stops.title: Lutz Continental Café & Pastry Shop
stops.description: Chicago's oldest German bakery-café, since 1948. Coffee + strudel.

stops.title: Andersonville Detour
stops.description: Brown Elephant resale, Lost Girls Vintage, Women & Children First bookstore.

stops.title: Spacca Napoli Pizzeria
stops.address: 1769 W Sunnyside Ave, Lincoln Square, Chicago
stops.description: Wood-fired Neapolitan pies. Backup: Il Milanese or Gene's Sausage Shop.

stops.title: Green Mill Cocktail Lounge
stops.description: Jazz club since 1907. Small cover, cash-friendly.

days.label: Saturday
days.title: River, Museum & Smartbar
days.objective: The big day: water taxi to Chinatown, the Art Institute, and a late night on the Smartbar floor.

stops.title: Geraldine's / Groundswell Coffee
stops.description: Cheap, quick breakfast around Giddings Plaza.

stops.title: Damen Brown Line → Loop
stops.description: Ride to the Loop (~30 min), then walk to the Michigan Ave Water Taxi dock.

stops.title: Water Taxi to Chinatown
stops.address: Chicago Water Taxi, Michigan Ave Dock
stops.description: $10 one-way pp, ~30 min scenic ride down the river.

stops.title: Wander & Dim Sum
stops.address: Ping Tom Memorial Park → Chinatown Square
stops.description: Dim sum, Chiu Quon Bakery, gift shops.

stops.title: Art Institute of Chicago
stops.description: $32/adult, open 11–5. Book ahead at artic.edu.

stops.title: Loop / Wrigleyville Cheap Eats
stops.address: Manny's Cafeteria & Delicatessen (Loop) or near Wrigleyville
stops.description: Chicago institution, cafeteria-style.

stops.title: Smartbar
stops.description: Leon Vynehall, Sorrbet, Moorhaus. Doors 10pm. Tickets via Etix.

days.label: Sunday
days.title: Thrift & Vinyl Crawl
days.objective: Sleep off Smartbar, then drift through Wicker Park & Logan Square. No alarms today.

stops.title: Wicker Park Farmers Market
stops.description: 8:00 AM–2:00 PM, Sundays through the season.

stops.title: Bongo Room
stops.address: 1470 N Milwaukee Ave, Wicker Park, Chicago
stops.description: Classic maximalist brunch spot. Expect a short wait.

stops.title: Reckless Records
stops.description: Flagship location, deep new/used selection.

stops.title: Dusty Groove
stops.description: World-famous for rare funk and soul.

stops.title: Kokorokoko
stops.description: '80s & '90s vintage. Also nearby: Richard's Fabulous Finds (2545 W North Ave).

stops.title: Big Star
stops.address: 1531 N Damen Ave, Wicker Park, Chicago
stops.description: Cheap, excellent tacos. Walk-ins only.

stops.title: Monarch Thrift Shop
stops.address: 2875 N Milwaukee Ave, Logan Square, Chicago
stops.description: Boutique-curated resale.

stops.title: Shuga Records — Logan Square
stops.address: Milwaukee Ave corridor, Logan Square, Chicago
stops.description: Deep catalog, in-store performances.

stops.title: The Whistler
stops.address: 2421 N Milwaukee Ave, Logan Square, Chicago
stops.description: Listening room: cocktails, live jazz & DJ sets. Alt: Sleeping Village (3734 W Belmont Ave).

days.label: Monday
days.title: Heading Home
days.objective: One more good coffee near home base, then hit the road. Kept intentionally open.

stops.title: Spoken Café or Lutz Continental Café
stops.description: Second chance at strudel before six hours in the car.

stops.title: Pack Up
stops.description: Load the car, point it toward I-90/94 E back to Lexington.

challengeDeck.title: Crate Dig
challengeDeck.description: Buy a record at any shop on the itinerary. Photo the sleeve. Bonus points if nobody's heard of it.

challengeDeck.title: Thrift Flex
challengeDeck.description: Wear or show off one thrifted item before day's end. Group votes on 'most improved' or 'most unhinged.'

challengeDeck.title: Culture Vulture
challengeDeck.description: Find a specific piece at the Art Institute and recreate its pose.

challengeDeck.title: Transit Merit Badge
challengeDeck.description: Navigate a leg (water taxi, bus, Blue Line) without pulling up Maps. Photo the 'we made it' moment.

challengeDeck.title: Local Flavor
challengeDeck.description: Order something you can't pronounce or have never had. One bite on camera.

challengeDeck.title: Dance Floor Diplomacy
challengeDeck.description: Get a stranger at Smartbar to teach you a move, or just capture the best dance-floor moment.

challengeDeck.title: Cheers a Stranger
challengeDeck.description: Toast with someone you just met. Water counts.

challengeDeck.title: Chicago-Only Order
challengeDeck.description: Order a drink that's a Chicago original (a Malort taste counts, but so does a local beer you've never had — no pressure either way).

challengeDeck.title: Secret's Out
challengeDeck.description: Tell the group something they don't know about you. Group votes best reveal.

challengeDeck.title: Do a Bit
challengeDeck.description: Impression, accent, or a full bit for 30 seconds. Group votes.

challengeDeck.title: Dare Wheel
challengeDeck.description: Wildcard dare, proposed by any player, group votes yes/no before it's official.

penalties.title: Last One Ready
penalties.description: Last person out the door in the morning.

penalties.title: Generic Tourist Photo
penalties.description: A Bean-selfie-tier photo with zero creativity.

wagerRound.label: Saturday night, pre-Smartbar — double-or-nothing wager round
wagerRound.description: Players can wager banked points on one high-stakes challenge before heading in.
